questions.def: Past cause, present result: 'would/could/might + be + -ing'.
questions.question: If I had studied harder, I ___ the exam now.

questions.def: Past cause, past result: 'would/could/might + have + past participle'.
questions.question: If she hadn't been so tired, she ___ to the party last night.

questions.def: Past cause, past result. Use past perfect after 'if'.
questions.question: If he ___ more confident, he would have asked her out.

questions.def: Past cause, present result: 'would/could/might + be'.
questions.question: If they hadn't missed the flight, they ___ in Paris now.

questions.def: Past unreal condition, present result: 'would/could/might + be'.
questions.question: She ___ happier if she had chosen a different career path.

questions.def: Past unreal condition, present result needs 'had listened'.
questions.question: If he has listened to my advice, he would not be in trouble now.

questions.def: Past unreal condition: use past perfect 'had + past participle'.
questions.question: If I ___ how difficult it was, I wouldn't have started.

questions.def: Present unreal condition, present result: 'would + be + -ing'.
questions.question: If I had the money, I ___ buying that car now.

questions.def: Past unreal condition, present result: 'had + past participle'.
questions.question: If they ___ earlier, they wouldn't be stuck in traffic now.

questions.def: Correct, no error. Tests mixed conditional knowledge.
questions.question: If she had studied medicine, she would be a doctor now.

questions.def: Past unreal condition affecting present result: 'had gone'.
questions.question: If he ___ to bed earlier, he wouldn't be so tired today.

questions.def: Present unreal condition, future/present result: 'would + base form'.

questions.def: Past unreal condition, past result: 'had + past participle'.
questions.question: If he ___ more carefully, he wouldn't have made that mistake yesterday.

questions.def: Past unreal condition, present result: needs 'had prepared'.

questions.def: Past unreal condition affecting present result: 'had invested'.
questions.question: If she ___ in that company, she would be rich now.

questions.def: Past unreal condition, past result: 'would have + past participle'.

questions.def: Past unreal condition, past result: 'would have + past participle'.

questions.def: Mixed conditional: 'would be' is incorrect here.
questions.question: If I hadn't missed the train, I would be there now.

questions.def: Past unreal condition, present result: 'had + past participle'.

questions.def: Past unreal condition, past result: 'would have + past participle'.

questions.def: Past cause, present result: if + past perfect, would + base verb.
